scope: Selected fork features at 8.36.0.0-JW; this is not an audit of every reachable commit.

features.title: Do not automatically share a group profile because a blocked inviter is a contact
features.reason: Add the fork's explicit blocked-contact guard to the trusted-inviter branch. An approval of a previous join request can avoid the existing blocked-new-inviter leave path, so the profile-sharing predicate must itself reject a blocked inviter.
features.verification: Six focused state-processor regressions cover blocked system/profile-sharing contacts accepting an earlier join request, both trusted unblocked contact types, hidden contacts, and unchanged blocked unsolicited-add behavior. Compilation and execution require the app PR checks.

features.title: Allow webpage previews without downloaded images
features.reason: Implemented a Collie proposal inspired by the fork's separate image preference. Unlike the reviewed fork code, the generic-web path gates before the optional image fetch and decode. A backed-up local preference defaults to true, with a Chats control below Generate link previews. Cache refresh, callback invalidation and conversation/story/share submission guards apply the latest preference, clear both thumbnail and attachment ID, and preserve special Signal cards without a global forwarding change.
features.verification: Added repository request-count and response-close tests, policy/metadata tests, legacy and V2 preview-cache/race tests, real share/story submission tests, settings persistence and ViewModel tests, and Compose screen tests. These app tests have not been compiled or executed in this environment; the app PR checks and API 35 screen verification remain required before merge.

features.title: Control which contacts can add the user to groups
features.reason: Broader group spam controls may be useful, but the fork dereferences addedBy before its null check, computes a full-member mayAdd value without using it, and reverses the pending-member decision in a linked-device branch. Port the narrow blocked-inviter profile guard now; redesign the admission state machine separately.
features.verification: Cover pending/full/requesting members, missing inviter data, primary/linked devices, self approvals, blocked contacts and explicit user acceptance before adding policy settings.

features.title: Delete attachments while keeping message text
features.reason: A useful storage feature with a larger data-lifecycle contract. Decide how local-only deletion interacts with linked-device sync, quotes, backups, message attachment counts and cached thread previews before porting the menu and database changes.
features.verification: Exercise mixed text/media messages, quoted attachments, linked devices, backup/restore, and refreshed thread/gallery views.

features.title: Focus the passphrase field when unlocking
features.reason: Collie already carries Molly's stateVisible and onResume requestFocus behavior. The fork's additional keyboard hiding after successful unlock is a lower-priority separate refinement; importing initial-focus changes would duplicate existing behavior.

features.title: Raw database, XML and WhatsApp import/export tools
features.reason: Do not import these implementations: raw export stages database/attachment secrets in external plaintext files; an empty password selects an unencrypted ZIP; archive failure is ignored before raw files are deleted; the feature family also adds MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE. Any future migration feature needs its own narrow storage and confidentiality design.

features.title: Bypass view-once and remote or admin deletion
features.reason: These changes alter message-retention semantics and sender expectations. They are outside the selected privacy and reliability improvements and must not accompany an unrelated feature port.

features.title: Internal-user, expiry and client-limit overrides
features.reason: Do not import internal-user status, expiry bypasses or maximum-device/share-limit overrides as part of this patchset. They change service assumptions and release behavior without being required by the selected features.

features.title: Google Maps controls and fork build overrides
features.reason: Collie retains its existing non-Google map and build/release configuration. Fork-specific Google Maps UI, branding, keys and build identity are not dependencies of the selected feature changes.
